items.title: Wire new resource modules into the service
items.summary: Imports the BulkCreateCustom and recurring ScheduledActions modules into the Microsoft.Compute service; this supporting change makes their separately versioned ARM declarations part of the compiled API surface.

items.title: Revise language-specific SDK customizations
items.summary: Removes C# alternate-type and property-name mappings and adds a C#/Java/Python client name for the custom InnerError type, changing language-specific generated names and types without changing the REST wire contract.

inferenceResults.rationale: The removed language-specific augment decorators directly change generated C# public types and member names.
The added client-name augment renames an existing custom error type in three generated language surfaces.

items.title: Add BulkCreateCustom and recurring ScheduledActions surfaces
items.summary: Adds ARM resource, list, action, and long-running operation surfaces plus supporting models for BulkCreateCustom and recurring ScheduledActions, and adds optional ExecutionParameters.optimizationPreference, all introduced in the existing 2026-07-06-preview version.

inferenceResults.rationale: The BulkCreateCustom hunk adds new ARM resource operations and models; the supplied evidence does not narrow or remove an existing REST or SDK contract.
The recurring ScheduledActions hunk adds new version-gated resource and action surfaces; the supplied evidence does not invalidate an existing REST or SDK contract.
